BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: Published build artifacts, such as client-side bundles, can be downloaded over the network.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Reading the published artifact is enough; no special conditions are needed.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: Published artifacts are usually public and need no authentication.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: No victim action is needed; the data is included at build time.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: Exposure stays within the same application and its secrets.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: Environment variables, API keys and credentials are exposed in clear text.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: Leaked credentials can be used for limited unauthorised changes.

BASE.name: AVAILABILITY
BASE.justification: There is no direct impact on availability.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
